alternatives.description: Keep Compare/Reason/Proof/Evidence separation as prose/frontier only.
alternatives.projected_effect: No new executable schema or CI enforcement.
alternatives.risk: Future material changes may conflate evidence, proof, reasoning, and authorization without machine detection.

alternatives.description: Add typed reasoning-bundle validation plus changed-action CI enforcement.
alternatives.projected_effect: Future changed production actions in the governed kernel path carry machine-checkable Compare/Reason/Proof/Evidence records while authorization remains external.
alternatives.risk: Adds validation and CI surface that may initially expose more FRONTIER rather than proving full GSL compliance.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING lacks explicit DO_NOTHING comparison, proof-obligation typing, and machine-enforced evidence/proof/authorization separation.
Candidate adds schema/validator maintenance burden and still leaves algebra/AAP/durable-audit closure for later WP-009 stages.

assumptions: Garden v15.5 and its five-file canonical source root remain immutable.
Authority and authorization continue to come only from the protected registry, trusted attestations, and ActionGate.
CI/test outcomes are evidence inputs and do not become authorization merely by passing.
reason.uncertainty: This slice proves typed separation and changed-action enforcement only; it does not prove semantic completeness, algebra conformance, AAP selection, durable audit, or repo-wide GSL certification.
counterexamples: A Reason receipt that says ALLOW must be rejected.
An Evidence receipt that claims authority or proof effect must be rejected.
A Proof receipt whose overall result disagrees with its obligations must be rejected.
A future material kernel change without a changed typed production action/reasoning bundle must fail the WP-009D CI audit.
reason.conclusion: Implement the typed separation as a bounded candidate and admit only after deterministic tests, FunctionContract audit, WP-009D conformance audit, and the existing production ActionGate all pass.

obligations.statement: Typed validator rejects Compare/Reason/Proof/Evidence sections that attempt to mint trust or authorization.
Compare requires explicit DO_NOTHING plus bidirectional candidate gaps.
Future changed production actions in the governed kernel path require exactly one DesignEpoch/source-root-bound reasoning bundle.
The trusted ActionGate remains the only authorization/admission owner for this action.

items.claim_scope: Canonical user source places Reason/Compare/Proof inside the safe evolution loop.
Canonical system source distinguishes evidence and proof bindings.
Predecessor private kernel CI is green before this candidate.
Latest zero-cost public review supplied no admissible new finding; it is not proof or authorization.
